desc: 柔粉花瓣底配品红圆环图标，痛点三宫格、原料卡与勾选利益层层递进
leaf: 婴幼儿泵头润肤保湿乳
name: 婴儿泵头润肤保湿乳柔粉花瓣款

shots.intent: 搜索列表第一眼：大瓶乳液全身立于柔粉花瓣场，干净高识别度拿点击。
shots.textZone: upper left carries a small Latin kicker plus a two-line plum headline slot; lower left band stays clear

shots.intent: 把换季与干燥环境的日常困扰做成三宫格圆环图标，承接首屏往下滑。
shots.textZone: headline slot top-centre, two-line label under each circle icon

shots.intent: 用三格原料卡解释配方思路，把抽象成分讲成可看的植物素材。
shots.textZone: headline slot above the grid, one magenta title line and one short grey line inside each tile

shots.intent: 左右两栏真实质地对照，一眼看懂稠润挂壁与稀薄流散的区别。
shots.textZone: one short label slot above each column plus one headline slot centred above the divider

shots.intent: 四行勾选清单配整瓶立像，把长文案压成四眼可扫的短句。
shots.textZone: four title-plus-one-line pairs stacked on the left, headline slot top left

shots.intent: 微距看泵头出料与乳液真实稠度，用材质细节建立品质信任。
把大瓶乳液放进真实抚触时刻，让家长会心带入而不越界。
无人物的高角度台面图，交代存放与取用场景，节奏缓冲。
90 度俯拍两种容量并排，让买家一步选完规格不再犹豫。
shots.textZone: one small label tag under each unit

shots.intent: 六行参数把信息交回真实资料，用空白行降风险而不编数据。
shots.textZone: six row-label and value slots on the right-hand card

shots.intent: 品红斜带加一句行动号召，完成详情页最后一步收口。
shots.textZone: one short call-to-action line on the magenta band, upper left clear

style.backgroundSystem: cloud white #FFFFFF fine-grain paper field for the copy screens, soft blush #FBEAF1 petal field with a few drifting petal shapes #F4C9DC for the hero and pain-point screens, one pale mint tile #E7F1EF plus a light greige tile #DEDAD6 as the ingredient-card grid, a diagonal blush band cut under the product, and a warm nursery-linen surface #F2EDE6 for scene screens
style.direction: soft blush baby-care lotion detail-page commerce
style.iconSystem: thin single-weight line icons in #E2197C inside a #E2197C circle outline of the same weight, plus empty square tick boxes drawn in #4A2545; no filled illustration, no badge artwork, no certificate graphics
style.lightingSystem: high-key neutral studio light, large soft front key with a gentle fill card, single-direction soft contact shadow only, no harsh specular, about 5500K; scene screens keep one consistent window-light direction
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent premium soft-blush baby-care lotion visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of cloud white #FFFFFF, blush field #FBEAF1, plum text #4A2545 and one magenta accent #E2197C with a single pale mint #E7F1EF supporting tile; neutral high-key studio lighting around 5500K with a large soft front key, fill card and one soft single-direction contact shadow; modern geometric sans-serif with a small letter-spaced Latin kicker over a two-line plum headline; thin single-weight magenta line icons inside magenta circle outlines and empty square tick boxes, no filled illustration and no badge artwork; drifting petal shapes and the product's own bloom mark as the only decorative motifs; stable slight 3/4 hero product angle and scale, product label always a blank legible field; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
noDrift: no redesign of the bottle silhouette, pump, shoulder or label placement; label stays a blank legible field
no medical, dermatological, cure or treatment wording, no efficacy guarantee and no symptom imagery
no ingredient percentages, no concentration or pH figures, no registration or filing number, no patent count, no dermatologist-tested, talc-free or hypoallergenic assertion, no lab or test report
no identifiable baby or adult face, every person stays anonymous with the back turned or cropped above the jaw
no real numbers, prices, QR codes, store logos or watermarks printed in frame
style.presentationRules: product upright and whole on every screen except the macro and the texture comparison; stable slight 3/4 hero angle and identical scale across the set; copy column stays clear so the product is never occluded; the product label is always rendered as a blank legible field carrying no readable brand wording
style.surfaceSystem: matte warm linen top #F2EDE6 and pale paper board #FAF7F5, plus a smooth blush acrylic sheet #FBEAF1 for the hero base
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif; one small letter-spaced Latin kicker above a two-line plum headline; headline 30-44pt, subtitle 16-20pt, label 12-16pt; all rendered copy stays short and placeholder-driven, Chinese copy wrapped in 「」
